mentions.name: Moveline
mentions.description: A native iOS app that fetches Apple Health and Strava workouts and visualizes all walks and runs on a single map. Privacy-focused: all data stays on the device. A time-lapse video option is planned for the next version.
mentions.problem: Wanted to visualize all walks and runs on a single map.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://moveline.app/

I wanted to visualize all my walks and runs on a single map. I built a native iOS app that fetches Apple Health and Strava workouts and visualizes them. Privacy was a major factor in building the app, so all the data stays on the device. Next version will have a time-lapse video option. Any feedback welcome.
